status: Fixed before reconstruction and local HP comparison

source_audit.AU: Read all 32 natural and 96 paired saved summaries. AU has streak/segment summaries rather than full action sequences.
source_audit.AV: Read existing 52 finite branch traces; count consecutive player mode+target. Branch interventions and a different policy mean they are supporting examples, not pooled independent natural journeys.
source_audit.AW: Existing 8 C action sequences cover first_clear and side_first, not the selected after_eight_returns and progress_first sample; do not substitute them for the missing AU sequence.

selection.rule: Select greatest saved max_same_mode_target_streak; break ties by label in ascending ASCII order. Reconstruct just that checkpoint history and run, select the first equal-maximum streak in chronological order, and assert its length equals the saved maximum.
selection.label: 0-A-after_eight_returns-C-progress_first-initial
selection.note: Outcome-independent longest-streak selection from old results. The two ties share a combat seed; only one is reconstructed and neither is counted as an independent replication.

reconstruction.journey: Use unchanged AU routeFor, public progress_first, public purchase eligibility/ranking and surplus sale policy; reproduce all eight saved natural endpoints, preparation, receipts, purchase results, boundaries and home totals.
reconstruction.paired: Recreate the selected paired preparation and complete that one original natural-state branch once, retaining each public pre-action view and save in memory; verify endpoint, receipt, boundaries and streak summary against AU.

intervention.rule: max(1, ceil(checkpoint target current HP * ratio)); do not change max_hp, posture, field, hand, cards, RNG, schedule, rewards, economy or any other saved field.
intervention.policy: Unchanged AH progress_first through only public(), choices() and predict(); re-evaluate after intervention and every action. Changed target HP may change card rankings, so this fixes the policy rather than all subsequent actions.
intervention.stop: First of selected-target retirement, existing game terminal outcome, or 24 additional P actions.
intervention.settlement: For natural terminal outcomes inspect the existing settlement. Otherwise make a separate withdrawal clone at the measured stop; never add its settlement to the measured branch or continue combat after target retirement.

measurements: Additional P actions and game ticks until the fixed stop; target HP/posture progress and player HP
Zero-HP attacks with probe progress separately from zero-HP-and-zero-probe attacks
Public pre-action states, actual action trace, hand/field/target-posture changes, distinct cards/materials and support actions
Leading same-mode/target streak, all nonattack preparation actions, legal attack targets and public alternative target policy
Exact initial save diff, source SHA256, original replay, restored first action, prediction/policy purity, existing reward settlement and preservation of previous possessions
limits: The original checkpoint is reached without manual state editing. hp75 and hp50 are diagnostic artificial states, not naturally observed encounters or adopted target values.
One selected checkpoint with three paired local branches; no population win rate, balance optimum, difficulty curve, boredom or human comprehension claim.
Same mode/target does not establish absent decisions or absent progress. Public hand, matching field, posture and timing can still change.
Game ticks are not wall-clock playtime. No fee, protection, actor count, event count, posture reset or formal specification changes.
